product_family: Machine translation and speech recognition platform with on-premise, API, and offline deployment options. Supports 100+ languages with desktop apps, browser extensions, and phone translation services.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence that Lingvanex holds a SOC 2 Type I attestation. The only on-domain reference is a self-published marketing comparison article ('Lingvanex vs. DeepL') whose feature table lists 'GDPR, SOC Type I, and SOC 2 Type II' as a product attribute alongside items like 'Offline Mode: True'; the same article notes that 'compliance certifications ... may change over time.' No SOC 2 audit report, attestation letter, or trust center substantiates the claim.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence that Lingvanex holds a SOC 2 Type II attestation. The only on-domain reference is a self-published marketing comparison article ('Lingvanex vs. DeepL') whose feature table lists 'GDPR, SOC Type I, and SOC 2 Type II' as a product attribute alongside items like 'Offline Mode: True'; the same article notes that 'compliance certifications ... may change over time.' No SOC 2 audit report, attestation letter, or trust center substantiates the claim.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification on vendor domain. Blog articles reference ISO 27001 as a framework customers should evaluate, but Lingvanex does not claim to hold this certification.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: individuals have the right to obtain a copy of their personal data (Article 15), right to rectification of inaccurate data (Article 16), right to have personal data erased (Article 17), data portability rights (Article 20)

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No HIPAA certification claimed. Marketing materials state solutions 'can be configured to align with HIPAA, SOC 2, and GDPR standards' but explicitly note: 'Final HIPAA compliance determinations must be based on a documented risk assessment, formal policies, and guidance from qualified legal or compliance professionals.'

privacy.ai_training_note: Terms state company reserves right to 'collect, use, and distribute demographic data' about users in non-identifying forms. Privacy policy does not explicitly state whether customer translations are used for model training. On-premise deployments process data locally with no cloud transmission; cloud API deployment model's training data usage is not clearly disclosed.
privacy.data_region: On-premise: customer-controlled. Cloud API: USA, Europe, Asia regions per customer location.

flags: UNVERIFIED SOC 2 CLAIMS: Blog article lists SOC 2 Type I and II certifications, but no independent audit report, trust center page, or third-party verification found. Claims appear in vendor's own marketing comparison article only. Recommend requesting SOC 2 audit letter before listing as certified.
NO DEDICATED TRUST CENTER: No formal trust/security page with verified certifications. All security information is dispersed across blog articles, privacy policy, and marketing pages.

HIPAA MARKETING LANGUAGE: Marketing materials use conditional language ('can be configured to align with HIPAA') which could mislead healthcare prospects. No formal HIPAA certification or BAA offered.

AI TRAINING DATA UNCLEAR: Terms reserve right to use 'demographic data' but policy does not clearly disclose whether customer translations improve models. On-premise avoids this; cloud API policy is ambiguous.
IDENTITY VERIFICATION COMPLETE: Nordicwise Limited, Cyprus-registered (HE 367059), confirmed via imprint page. No identity conflation risk. Company ~7 years old, 40 employees, growth-stage vendor.

PARTIAL CERT PORTFOLIO: Compared to competitors (DeepL: ISO 27001 + SOC 2 + GDPR + HIPAA), Lingvanex holds fewer verified certifications. Strength is in on-premise architecture, not compliance pedigree.
